notes: Eight facts. PesaLink (scheme-level facts from IPSL plus one KCB bank page) and KEPSS settlement behaviour from the CBK's December 2024 PFMI assessment. What is NOT asserted: no document in the corpus states that M-PESA can be addressed directly as a PesaLink participant, so no such claim is made; M-PESA-to-other-network mobile money is documented only as a priced tariff row, not as a named rail.

sources.name: Central Bank of Kenya, KEPSS assessment against the PFMI principles, December 2024
Integrated Payment Services Limited, PesaLink FAQs
KCB Bank Kenya, PesaLink product page

entries.subject: pesalink_operator
entries.value_text: Integrated Payment Services Limited (IPSL), owned by the Kenya Bankers Association, established 2015 under the National Payment System Act
entries.display: PesaLink is run by IPSL, a KBA-owned company set up in 2015
entries.quote: pesalink is operated by integrated payment services limited ipsl and owned by kenya bankers association kba ipsl was established in 2015 under the national payment system nps act

entries.subject: pesalink_scope
entries.value_text: An open, instant, interoperable network moving funds between banks, mobile money, Saccos and fintech wallets
entries.display: PesaLink is not bank-only: mobile money, Saccos and fintech wallets are participants
entries.quote: pesalink is an instant open and interoperable payment network facilitating the transfer of funds from one store of value to another bank account mobile money saccos fintech wallets etc via online banking bank mobile app or ussd of up to ksh 999 999

entries.subject: pesalink_per_transaction_limit
entries.display: PesaLink will carry up to KSh 999,999 per transaction
entries.quote: you can transfer up to 999 999 per transaction however your bank may have limits for security reasons
entries.notes: The scheme ceiling is 999,999; the sending bank may impose a lower cap.

entries.subject: pesalink_pricing_model
entries.value_text: No central scheme tariff: each participant bank sets its own PesaLink charges
entries.display: PesaLink fees vary by bank; there is no single national price
entries.quote: fees will vary from bank to bank kindly contact your bank for specific charges
entries.notes: Observed spread: Family Bank KSh 50 for 1,001-10,000 (2020), NCBA KSh 20 flat above 1,000 (2026), KCB advertises transfers from KSh 10.

entries.subject: pesalink_ussd_code
entries.display: KCB customers reach PesaLink on USSD 522
entries.quote: dial 522 select send money select pesalink instant transfer follow the prompts
entries.notes: Bank-specific USSD short code, not a scheme-wide code; other banks use their own. enum_match set: {*522#}.

entries.subject: kepss_clearing_sources
entries.value_text: ACH, DhowCSD, PesaLink, Interswitch and Kenswitch card clearings and CDSC securities clearings settle in KEPSS each day
entries.display: PesaLink is one of several retail clearings that net-settle in the central RTGS
entries.quote: at present clearings from ach dhowcsd pesalink card switches interswitch and kenswitch cdsc for securities are settled in kepss each day

entries.subject: rtgs_settlement_window
entries.display: RTGS accepts payment instructions 08:25-16:30 on weekdays
entries.quote: payment instructions may be submitted to rtgs for settlement between 8 25am and 4 30pm monday to friday
entries.notes: PesaLink itself is advertised as 24/7; the underlying RTGS window is weekday-only, so value dating differs.

entries.subject: settlement_finality
entries.value_text: A payment settled in KEPSS is final and irrevocable once the payer's account is debited and the payee's credited
entries.display: Interbank settlement cannot be reversed once settled
entries.quote: payment instructions in kepss are deemed final and irrevocable once the sending participants account is debited and the receiving participant is credited
